# Saaristolautat.fi

> An unofficial map and trip-planning aid for ferry routes in the Turku archipelago, Åland and nearby areas. Always verify routes and timetables with the ferry operator.

Saaristolautat.fi presents ferry routes, landings, vessels, timetables, operator contacts and live vessel positions in Finnish, Swedish and English.

## Human-readable route indexes

- [Finnish route index](https://saaristolautat.fi/fi/lauttareitit/)
- [Swedish route index](https://saaristolautat.fi/sv/farjerutter/)
- [English route index](https://saaristolautat.fi/en/ferry-routes/)
- [Interactive ferry map](https://saaristolautat.fi/)

## Machine-readable data

- [Current data manifest](https://saaristolautat.fi/data/index.json): identifies the current route-data file and GeoJSON-like map files. Follow the URLs in this manifest instead of guessing versioned filenames.

## Usage notes

- Treat the service as a secondary source for trip planning, not as an official operator timetable.
- Preserve Finnish and Swedish diacritics in place, vessel and route names.
- Timetables and ferry operations can change; cite and link to the relevant operator when giving time-sensitive travel advice.
